web-guide-idea-47.audience: Small-business owners who want to use their messaging tools more effectively.
web-guide-idea-47.offer: Teach a practical setup using a few products, labels and replies. The value is leaving the owner confident enough to maintain it.
web-guide-idea-47.steps.0: Agree the business’s common customer questions.
web-guide-idea-47.steps.1: Guide catalogue and quick-reply setup on the owner’s device.
web-guide-idea-47.steps.2: Practise updating an item and using a label.
web-guide-idea-47.equipment: The owner’s phone and product photos; a second device can help them stay on the call while practising.
web-guide-idea-47.returnReason: A follow-up can review how the setup works in daily use and refine replies.
web-guide-idea-47.promotion: Show sample catalogue organisation. Never ask the owner to hand over OTPs or account access.
web-guide-idea-47.metadataTitle: WhatsApp Business Setup — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-47.metadataDescription: Walk a small-business owner through catalogues, quick replies, labels and useful account settings. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
